ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_loss_sum
ir.intuition: This loss uses the advantage gap as a quality signal to emphasize preference margins and applies a logsigmoid link to encourage correct ranking. The aggregation structure shifts from mean to sum, amplifying the impact of highly weighted pairs.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l - beta * advantage_gap
losses = -logsigmoid(margin)
loss = sum(weight * losses)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(beta, adv))
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin))
    weighted_losses = ops.mul(losses, weight)
    return ops.sum(weighted_losses)
